THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, do hereby declare, under Sub - section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act. Allotments of lands depicted in below names and extents in the Advance Tracing No. GM/MAH/2022/536 dated 23.03.2023 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the village called Ihala Karagahamuna in the Grama Niladhari Division No.248 of Ihala Karagahamuna North in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Mahara in Gampaha District of the Western Province and bounded as follows:

Gamini ; South: Lot B, Thelembugahakumbura of which the claimant could not be traced and Thelembugahakumbura claimed by K.A.Anil Gamini; West: Thelembugahakumbura claimed by K. A. Anil Gamini. Thelembugahakumbura of which the claimant could not be traced and Lot No. 285 of P.P.GAM 3810.
